sloka: स्मृतिर्वा नास्ति ते मन्ये व्यक्तं वा यमसादनम्।गन्तुमिच्छसि यस्मात्त्वं मां धर्षयितुमिच्छसि ।। ६.८९.११ ।।
transliteration: smṛtirvā nāsti te manye vyaktaṁ vā yamasādanam।gantumicchasi yasmāttvaṁ māṁ dharṣayitumicchasi ।। 6.89.11 ।।

translations.english: "Knowing my valour, you have come. Have you lost memory or do you desire to go to Yama's abode? Tell me."
